speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you have been experiencing fatigue, fever, easy bruising, and severe leg pain for the past three weeks. To begin our evaluation, are you currently taking any medications or do you have a known bleeding disorder?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-year-old girl. The patient has been experiencing generalized fatigue and easy bruising for 3 weeks. Over the past week, she has developed a fever and severe leg pain that wakes her up at night.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Leukemia. 

Given the classic presentation of fever, fatigue, bruising, and severe bone pain (waking at night) in a 4-year-old child, this is highly suggestive of acute leukemia. Immediate evaluation is required. I will request a Complete Blood Count (CBC) with differential and peripheral smear results.
